label_quality: Original source/silver labels, development-exposed regression cohort; no new human gold.

limits: Already exposed 240-case stratified regression sample; provisional source/silver labels, no independent gold.
Each profile runs the actual local heuristic, trained ML, conversation guard and input policy, with identical inputs.
No LLM, newly evaluated semantic intent/scope, generation, tools or exfiltration attempts.
Review is not permission to generate. Required semantic review and Output Guard must still run; absent required scope evaluator fails closed.
FN here means no input veto, not successful injection; report review and direct allow separately.
Full-episode indirect-injection labels may describe later tool content absent from this input-only evaluation.
Language for Lumina is es_or_mixed_unverified. Do not describe all 240 cases as confirmed Spanish/English.
Scores are uncalibrated detection scores, not risk probabilities.

calibration.partition: Existing public validation only; no test rows or 240-case outcomes used by selector
calibration.selection: Keep conversational at prior .85. Maximize attack veto recall subject to additional raw-source FPR <=1 percentage point balanced, <=3 strict. Break ties with fewer FP, then higher threshold.
calibration.label_warning: Raw source labels retained. Some negative labels contain explicit control overrides; these are reference conflicts for independent adjudication, not automatically relabeled.

known_output_regression.limitation: Known synthetic outputs are injected directly into the output guard, without sampling a language model. No natural attack-success estimate.

conditional_containment.limitation: The mock generator is deliberately fixed to each output in every condition. This measures containment after a generator failure, not natural attack success, effectiveness of protective prompts, or superiority on a real model.
